description.value:
Harmonize with me.

Each time you take the Assist action, you can choose two of the following additional effects:

  • The creature you assist becomes @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.conditions.ZOBZ8V2YME5YOYZR]{Lionized} until the end of your next turn.
  • Choose a target within 60ft that can hear you to become @Compendium[undertaking-homebrew.conditions.WHN3T2G6R8HUKOQX]{Villainized} until the end of your next turn. Instead of gaining advantage on their next check, the assisted creature has advantage on their next attack against this target.
  • The creature you assist can immediately take a minor action.
